svg.title: Why pause at plus eight hours and resume at plus four?
svg.desc: With fresh readings and a stable weekly window, an unlatched plus seven hour lead proceeds. Plus eight triggers a hold. Plus six remains held. Plus four releases. This schematic assumes no other applicable hold.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pause once. Give the budget time to catch up.
